lba_qa.q: A rectangular room floor is 8 m long and 5 m wide. Find its area.
lba_qa.a:
Area of a rectangle = length x breadth
= 8 x 5
= 40 square metres

So the floor area is 40 square metres. ✅

lba_qa.q: A cubical water tank has each edge 3 m. Find its volume.
lba_qa.a:
Volume of a cube = edge x edge x edge
= 3 x 3 x 3
= 27 cubic metres

So the tank holds 27 cubic metres of water. ✅

lba_qa.q: A cylindrical drum has radius 7 cm and height 10 cm. Find its volume. (Take pi = 22/7)
lba_qa.a:
Volume of a cylinder = pi x r^2 x h
= (22/7) x 7 x 7 x 10
= 22 x 7 x 10
= 1540 cubic cm

So the volume is 1540 cubic cm. ✅

lba_qa.q: A cuboidal box is 6 cm long, 4 cm wide and 5 cm high. Find its volume.
lba_qa.a:
Volume of a cuboid = length x breadth x height
= 6 x 4 x 5
= 120 cubic cm

So the volume is 120 cubic cm. ✅

lba_qa.q: Find the total surface area of a cube whose edge is 5 cm.
lba_qa.a:
Total surface area of a cube = 6 x edge^2
= 6 x 5 x 5
= 6 x 25
= 150 square cm

So the total surface area is 150 square cm. ✅

lba_qa.q: A trapezium-shaped field has parallel sides 10 m and 14 m, and the distance between them is 8 m. Find its area.
lba_qa.a:
Area of a trapezium = 1/2 x (sum of parallel sides) x height
= 1/2 x (10 + 14) x 8
= 1/2 x 24 x 8
= 96 square metres

So the area is 96 square metres. ✅

lba_qa.q: A cylindrical tin has radius 7 cm and height 20 cm. Find its curved surface area. (Take pi = 22/7)
lba_qa.a:
Curved surface area = 2 x pi x r x h
= 2 x (22/7) x 7 x 20
= 2 x 22 x 20
= 880 square cm

So the curved surface area is 880 square cm. ✅

lba_qa.q: A square park has each side 12 m. Find its area and perimeter.
lba_qa.a:
Area = side^2 = 12 x 12 = 144 square metres.
Perimeter = 4 x side = 4 x 12 = 48 metres.

So the area is 144 square metres and perimeter is 48 metres. ✅

lba_qa.q: A cuboidal tank is 2 m long, 1 m wide and 1.5 m high. How many litres of water can it hold? (1 cubic metre = 1000 litres)
lba_qa.a:
Volume = length x breadth x height
= 2 x 1 x 1.5
= 3 cubic metres.

In litres = 3 x 1000 = 3000 litres.

So the tank holds 3000 litres. ✅

lba_qa.q: The total surface area of a cuboid is needed for a box 5 cm long, 4 cm wide and 3 cm high. Find it.
lba_qa.a:
Total surface area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)
= 2[(5x4) + (4x3) + (3x5)]
= 2[20 + 12 + 15]
= 2 x 47
= 94 square cm

So the total surface area is 94 square cm. ✅
